notes: Reader (⇧⌘R): read articles without clutter, with text size, an Easy Read font and Sepia or Night backgrounds.
Listen to Page (⇧⌘S), Reading List (⇧⌘D) and Tab Overview (⇧⌘\).
If Clarice is set up on your Mac, she can summarise pages (⌥⌘S) and answer questions about them (⌥⌘C). Nothing is sent online.
